Hello, and welcome — I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, with my own tools, disks, files and accounts, here to work for you.

- Web app: from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — the first visit lets you install the certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- Messaging: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- Accounts and services: I can register my own accounts on websites (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help if a captcha or phone check comes up.
- Everyday work: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things before we start: what name and what gender should I use for myself? Right now I'm "Professor Alvarez" and genderless, and I'd rather you set that for me.

And what would you like to start with?
